title: gnaphalium griquense
intro: Gnaphalium griquense, commonly known as Griqua everlasting, is a plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in South African folk medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Gnaphalium griquense include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as treating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
